text:
ana: Quick sync — finalizing Q3 compliance launch criteria. Need final call on audit-log retention lanes + BYOK escrow opt-in and export SLAs. Pinging team for quick triage.

mike: My take: default retention should be 90d. Anything longer is a paid tier. Finserv customers will want 7y but treat that as enterprise only.

jordan: +1 to 90d default. Two questions: 1) what is the export SLA for legal hold, and 2) do we promise searchable logs vs just raw export?

sree: Ops preference: warm exports (searchable slices) within 72h, cold bulk exports within 7 days. Warm requires reserved pool.

lucy: Legal flagged BYOK escrow. They want explicit escrow contract language and rotation guarantees before we offer escrow.

kevin: Security note — we should not auto-escrow customer keys. Proposal: BYOK default = customer-managed keys (no escrow). Escrow available as opt-in via signed legal addendum + attestation. Also require HSM-backed escrow and periodic audit.

ana: (correction) -> ana: Actionable summary so far: retention lanes: 90d(default), 1y(premium), 7y(enterprise). Export SLA: warm 72h, cold 7d. BYOK: customer keys by default; escrow opt-in via contract + HSM + attestation. Need ops/finance cost estimates and acceptance criteria.

ops-bot: Deploy-side note: reserving a Dedicated pool for warm exports adds infra cost. Rough estimate: 2 engineers x 2 weeks to build runbook + infra automation; ~monthly infra delta TBD.

mike: I'll scope pricing delta for retention tiers and add to the cost model.

jordan: Acceptance criteria (to add to PRD): 1) TTL enforcement e2e tests, 2) on-demand export workflow with monitoring + SLA alerting, 3) audited BYOK handshake (key import, rotation, escrow opt-in), 4) canary rollout to 10 tenants. Target: canary in 2 sprints after PRD sign-off. :eyes:

lucy: I'll draft the escrow contract language and required attestation checklist by EOD tomorrow.

sree: Ops will sketch the runbook and export job sizing by Thursday.

ana: Great — if no objections I'll add this to the roadmap (Q3 compliance milestone) and open a PRD draft. Please react or reply if anything missing. :thumbsup:

mike: :thumbsup:

jordan: :+1:

ana: Small reference snippet for the PRD (paste into doc):

```
Retention matrix:
- default: 90d
- premium: 1y
- enterprise: 7y

Export SLA:
- warm (searchable slices): 72h
- cold (bulk archive): 7d

BYOK behavior:
- default: managed keys (Redwood)
- opt-in: customer-keystore + escrow via contract (HSM, attestation, rotation policy)
```

ana: Thanks all — I'll track items as tasks and flag dependencies (Dedicated pool, contract signoff, finance pricing).
